segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Behold, I will send my messenger, and he shall prepare the way before me: and the Lord, whom ye seek, shall suddenly come to his temple, even the messenger of the covenant, whom ye delight in: behold, he shall come,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: But who may abide the day of his coming? and who shall stand when he appeareth? for he is like a refiner’s fire, and like fullers’ soap:

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And he shall sit as a refiner and purifier of silver: and he shall purify the sons of Levi, and purge them as gold and silver, that they may offer unto the LORD an offering in righteousness.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Then shall the offering of Judah and Jerusalem be pleasant unto the LORD, as in the days of old, and as in former years.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers, and against false swearers, and against those that oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and that turn aside the stranger from his right, and fear not me,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: For I am the LORD, I change not; therefore ye sons of Jacob are not consumed.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: ¶ Even from the days of your fathers ye are gone away from mine ordinances, and have not kept them. Return unto me, and I will return unto you,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: People
segments.text: But ye said, Wherein shall we return?

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: ¶ Will a man rob God? Yet ye have robbed me.

segments.speaker: People
segments.text: But ye say, Wherein have we robbed thee?

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: In tithes and offerings.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Ye are cursed with a curse: for ye have robbed me, even this whole nation.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and
prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts,

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And all nations shall call you blessed: for ye shall be a delightsome land,
saith the LORD of hosts.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: ¶ Your words have been stout against me,
saith the LORD.

segments.speaker: People
segments.text: Yet ye say, What have we spoken so much against thee?

segments.speaker: People
segments.text: Ye have said, It is vain to serve God: and what profit is it that we have kept his ordinance, and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of hosts?

segments.speaker: People
segments.text: And now we call the proud happy; yea, they that work wickedness are set up; yea, they that tempt God are even delivered.

footnotes: are set up: Heb. are built

segments.text: ¶ Then they that feared the LORD spake often one to another: and the LORD hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared the LORD, and that thought upon his name.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: And they shall be mine,
saith the LORD of hosts, in that day when I make up my jewels;

segments.speaker: the Lord of Hosts
segments.text: and I will spare them, as a man spareth his own son that serveth him.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: Then shall ye return, and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him that serveth God and him that serveth him not.
